O sequenciamento ITS e a identificação b: The ITS sequencing and botanical identification can employ different names for the same taxon. Without conciliation, a synonym may seem exclusive to the soil or field. With the nomenclature resolution, the two sets are compared by the accepted names. The original matrix of counts is not changed, the species of the literature are not added and the resolution of the ITS identification is not artificially improved.

Order, Family, Genus e Species; filtros: Order, family, genus and species analyses require at least 10 reads in the contrast and detection in three units. DESeq2 uses raw counts with positive-count size factors and the applicable design. ALDEx2 uses 128 Monte Carlo instances and all features for the log-ratio denominator. Concordance requires q < 0.05 and agreement on effect direction for both methods. The four-rank comparison is exploratory.

P: t pareado entre campanhas elegíveis;: Parametric tests used a paired t-test for eligible campaigns, Welch’s t-test for two independent groups and Welch’s ANOVA for multiple groups. The primary nonparametric tests were paired Wilcoxon, Mann–Whitney and Kruskal–Wallis. Tests required four pairs or three independent units per group. Spatial tests retained one unit per transect and campaign. We applied Benjamini–Hochberg correction across metrics and contrasts within each dataset and test class. The tables specify the sample sizes, statistics, exclusions, diagnostics and units used.
Para cada nível, calcula-se a interseção: For each level, the intersection of sets of distinct names ITS and field is calculated before and after reconciling accepted and synonym names.This panel exclusively uses Scale = Regional and the Common column of each treatment. Difference = WCVP v16 less Original. There is no statistical test or use of occurrences in the literature.

Soma das leituras atribuídas ao táxon na: Sum of the reads attributed to the taxon in the units evaluated; it does not measure individuals.

Soma de contagens por unidade e grupo/ca: Sum of counts per unit and group/campaign, division by total; residual Others is less than 1% in each bar, with categories consistent in the panel.
Sum of reads assigned in the clipping.
Soma de leituras da ASV nas unidades con: Sum of ASV reads in the units considered.
Soma de leituras por unidade/grupo e cam: Sum of reads per unit/group and campaign, aggregation by level and conversion into percentage; residual category Others less than 1% per bar in the current review.
Soma por grupo/campanha e divisão pelo t: Sum per group/campaign and division by total; visual selection by abundance.
Somar ASVs pelo nome original; exigir ≥1: Add ASVs by original name; require ≥1, 2, 3 or 5 positive units; maintain fixed field list and recalculate intersection/Jaccard.
Somar contagens por nível e unidade/grup: Add scores per level and unit/group, calculate proportions and apply residual strictly less than 1% per bar for display.
Somar leituras por táxon e unidade e div: Add tax and unit reads and divide by total unit reads.
Somar por nível; normalizar pelo total d: Add by level; normalize by the total number of reads of the unit for abundance or binarize positive count for presence/absence.

Uma ASV abaixo do corte de um rank é man: An ASV below the cut of a rank is maintained as Not classified in that rank; higher eligible levels and gross counts are not discarded. Relative abundance uses all vegetable reads as denominator; nominal wealth, Venn and agreement excludes those not classified. WCVP reconciles the original name without promoting an uneligible rank.
Uma barra de um grupo representa exclusi: A bar of one group represents exclusive to the other selected groups. If there is only one group, it represents all the taxa of this group and there is no comparison. Several groups: detection in all indicated groups and none of the others.
Uma entrega somente é aprovada depois da: A delivery is only approved after reviewing sensitive data, images and published files. This page does not automatically approve scientific data.
Uma linha por ASV e New_Field_ID positiv: A line by ASV and New_Field_ID positive, with counts and metadata. Select a point to restrict the table. The table requires the matrix ASV × unit; if unavailable in the approved publication, no occurrence is invented.
Uma unidade de detecção é um New_Field_I: A detection unit is a distinct New_Field_ID, not a plateau. The minimum number represents molecular recurrence; the botanical list remains fixed. It is not an inferential test.
Uma unidade é New_Field_ID, não uma geof: One unit is New_Field_ID, not a geofacies or a plateau. Requireing two units means detecting the same taxon in at least two distinct IDs, regardless of the area. The field list is fixed. Recurrence is not a significance test.
Unidade com maior soma de leituras da AS: Unit with higher sum of reads of the ASV; Mixed when there is tie.
Unidades de campo com pelo menos uma lei: Field units with at least one reading assigned.
